items.title: Deadline to file Einspruch against amended 2024 income tax assessment
items.quote: Einzulegen ist er innerhalb eines Monats seit der Bekanntgabe – schriftlich, elektronisch oder mündlich zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: Letter dated (and presumed posted) 29.12.2025. Delivery fiction for simple letter: 4th day after posting, day of posting not counted: Dec 30 (1), Dec 31 (2), Jan 1 2026 (3), Jan 2 2026 (4) → deemed delivery = Fri 02.01.2026. This is a Finanzamt, so if the 4th day were a Sat/Sun/holiday it would move to the next working day (§108 Abs.3 AO), but 02.01.2026 is a Friday and not a holiday, so no shift applies. One-month Einspruch period (§355 Abs.1 AO) runs from delivery per §§187 Abs.1, 188 Abs.2 BGB/§108 Abs.1 AO: delivery day itself not counted, period ends on the day in the following month with the same number as the delivery day → 02.02.2026. That date is a Monday (Jan 2026: Jan1=Thu, Jan2=Fri, so Jan30=Fri, Jan31=Sat, Feb1=Sun, Feb2=Mon), not a weekend/holiday in NRW, so no further shift under §108 Abs.3 AO.
